name_note: GTDB's Avelusimicrobium corresponds to the genus of that name in Elusimicrobiaceae, while many genomes placed here carry the broader NCBI deposit label Elusimicrobium.

sentences.text: Avelusimicrobium is a genus proposed in the family Elusimicrobiaceae, within the phylum Elusimicrobiota.
The authors describe this phylum as containing only two described species and as having been only poorly explored.
The genus was proposed from high-quality genomes of uncultured representatives, in an analysis that included more than 100 metagenome-assembled genomes of uncultured Elusimicrobiaceae lineages.
A study of the naked mole-rat gut reported Avelusimicrobium within Elusimicrobiota among metagenome-assembled genomes of termite-gut-associated bacteria.
